description:
Terms used to specify items to return in an aggregation data response. 
In practice we can use the the `id` field from existing filtering terms and avoid
the additional modifiers, but additionally allows the use of custom summary
structures beyond aggregaion corresponding to query filters; e.g.

* a `survivalGroups` term could aggregate data by survival groups
* a `cnvfrequencies` term could invoke a list of objects for gain, loss, ...
  events per genomic interval in the matched data
* a path to an attribute in the model (e.g. `biosample.histologicalDiagnosis.id`)
  to retrieve a distribution of values in the field (with their counts)

Alphanumeric filters usually can be used in form of a full stringified
valued expression, e.g. `sexAtBirth:=female` to allow counts on this specific
value (see <https://docs.genomebeacons.org/filters/#alphanumerical-value-queries>).
title: Aggregation Terms
